changeKinds.ADDED: A new obligation, with its text, source, packets and scope, and optional shares for its packets.
changeKinds.REFINED: Plan v2's packet in an obligation's list is replaced by its named parts; the text stays byte-identical to plan v2's; shares may name the parts or any other packet in the list after the change.
changeKinds.PACKETS_ADDED: Packets added to an obligation's list, each with its share, as in amendment 1.
changeKinds.SHARE_CORRECTED: One packet's share from an earlier amendment is corrected as a quoted owner decision directs: the row names the share it corrects (`corrects`), quotes the replaced words byte for byte (`replaced`), gives the words that replace them (`replacement`) and the whole corrected share (`shares`); the obligation's text and packet list stay as they are. Unlike other shares it may narrow, but only as far as the quoted decision does.

packetScopes.scope: HE-004D1 builds in R10 the policy observer's native-profile v4 captures (one P1 capture per resident role, the P5 lifecycle capture and one backend capture per component) and the inspector policy (NP-3), with the capture-family checks whose vectors it replays, as owner decisions Q-HE4D1-1..12 (a) shape them (`decisions`). Captures stay in-memory records (Q-HE4-10 (a)); check_qualification and the acceptance token stay HE-004D2's (I06-2). The host policy its captures need outside matrix v5 and v6 is OBS-HOSTPOL-1's (HE-008, T04).
packetScopes.np3Route: NP-3's text stays plan v2's byte for byte (architecture/w03-plan-v2/plan.json:287, row :284-292). Its first clause, "Inspection freezes through an ancestor", is replaced by NP-9 and is not met by the inspector: under Q-HE4-3/4 (a) (architecture/w03-obligation-amendment-2/amendment.json:18) the observer has no cgroup write grant and freezes nothing, ancestors included (architecture/native-profile-v4/README.md:284); under Q-NP4D-8 (a) (:282) and Q-NP4D-10 (a) (:302-303) the frozen state a WORKER capture needs comes from the broker's own write to its probe-worker leaf (NP-9). Its second clause, "never writes the broker leaf's cgroup.freeze", is structural (:310-311). HE-004D1 discharges the rest through native-profile v4's inspector obligation (:282-311). This records what those decisions did and narrows nothing beyond them.

changes.text: The broker freezes the probe-worker leaf at quiescent points of the worker's run and thaws it after, so that the policy observer can take a WORKER capture inside a frozen bracket: cgroup.events shows frozen 1 before and after the observer's reads, and the (pid, start) member sets and (tid, start) thread sets are equal before and after. The observer itself never freezes and never writes any cgroup.freeze (NP-3). Until the broker freezes the leaf, no WORKER capture qualifies; the residual is availability, not safety.

shares.HE-005: the quiescent-point freeze and thaw of the probe-worker leaf, through its cgroup.freeze write grant on its delegated leaves (architecture/selinux-matrix-v3/README.md:219; unchanged in matrix v6, architecture/selinux-matrix-v4/README.md:632), beside the freezes of W1-W4 and W6 (architecture/host-interface-amendment-hs43/HOST_INTERFACE_SPEC.md:462-477, :482-486). A quiescent freeze is taken only on a leaf that W1-W4 or W6 does not already hold frozen; its thaw never thaws a leaf that W1-W4 or W6 holds frozen; an expiry or invalidation inside a quiescent bracket proceeds to W6 without thawing. Each quiescent freeze holds for at least one 2 s inspection window, aligned with the observer's 60 s cycle (the NP-9 minimum). Everything else about the points (their definition, frequency and duration beyond that minimum) is HE-005's design (Q-A3-4 (a), refined by the NP-9 minimum).
shares.HE-004D1: the frozen-bracket logic, built and tested against fakes: a WORKER capture is attempted only when cgroup.events shows frozen 1, qualifies only inside the bracket, and is otherwise refused and retried without exit
shares.T04: proves on the enrolled host that the broker's quiescent freeze reaches frozen 1 on the probe-worker leaf and holds for at least one 2 s inspection window aligned with the observer's 60 s cycle, that the observer's WORKER capture is taken inside the bracket, that a quiescent thaw never thaws a leaf W1-W4 or W6 holds frozen, and that the observer writes no cgroup.freeze

shareRule: A share adds to the named packet's part of the obligation as plan v2 states it; it never narrows it. A share may name any packet in the obligation's list after the change, and a later share for the same packet adds to its earlier shares (amendments 1 and 2 and this amendment). The one exception is a SHARE_CORRECTED row: its share replaces the earlier share it corrects, and later shares for that packet add to the corrected one.
correctionRule: Each SHARE_CORRECTED row corrects one packet's share from one amendment bound in `after`: its `replaced` words occur exactly once in that share, the corrected share is that share with them replaced by `replacement`, `packets` is the obligation's list after amendment 2, unchanged, and its decision is quoted in `ownerDecisions`. Rows for one obligation apply in order, after amendments 1 and 2.
packetScopeRule: A packet scope records how a part named in amendment 2's packetRefinements discharges its obligations as its quoted decisions direct, with the residuals they accept. It adds to the part's summary and shares and never narrows them; an item it hands to another packet names that packet and the decision (`handOffs`); it states no status.
